theme: Forest Dawn — Moving Woodland and Gentle Birdsong
title: Forest Dawn | 1 Hour of Gentle Woodland Birdsong
description:
Gentle bird calls, soft woodland textures and naturally moving leaves. Forest Dawn pairs an hour of real stereo field recordings from the UK, Slovakia and Belgium with real filmed woodland in Mount Dandenong, Australia. These recordings and pictures come from different places; the soundtrack is not presented as the original sound of the pictured scene.

Long, unrepeated audio passages are joined with smooth transitions. The stabilized woodland footage repeats with a gentle visual crossfade. Enjoy a quiet hour for reading, writing or easing into your day.

#Birdsong #ForestAmbience #NatureSounds #QuietHours

Audio changes: five distinct passages selected without repeating an interval, level matched and joined with 16-second crossfades, with measured loudness adjustment and true-peak headroom.

Visual recording: View from our back veranda — Matthew Paul Argall (2021).

The woodland was filmed in Mount Dandenong, Victoria, Australia, according to its creator. The separate soundtrack is not synchronous location sound.

Thumbnail: derived from the same Matthew Paul Argall footage under CC BY 4.0, with AI-assisted cream title and gold badge design. The video backdrop itself is real filmed footage.
